svg.aria-label: Sargantana seven-stage core with pre-commit DFI: prefetcher at decode, RR request, GL tap, mem_unit tap and DFI controller
svg.text: Seven-stage core · in-order issue · out-of-order execution · up to 2 in-order retirements · DFI check gates load graduation
mem + custom0 pair · load needs DFI OK
Native arbitration / SID routing · nonblocking misses / MSHRs · write buffer
Request table · indexed by GL entry
RDSmap / RDSet reads · RDTable read / update · shared arbitration
RR → DFI Controller: defID · L/S · GL entry
Dashed purple outline: baseline block modified for DFI
Sources: supplied Sargantana baseline / pre-commit flow · Sargantana paper §III · Feng et al., RVDFI §4
